{| width="100%"

{{{file}}}
| valign="middle" style="margin-left: 15px; padding-left: 15px;" |
<big>'''[[User:{{{username}}}|{{{username}}}]]''' {{#switch:{{{flag|}}}
|au=<span style="cursor: help;" title="Australia">[[File:AdminBox-Flag-au.svg|30px]]</span>
|ca=<span style="cursor: help;" title="Canada">[[File:AdminBox-Flag-ca.svg|30px]]</span>
|fi=<span style="cursor: help;" title="Finland">[[File:AdminBox-Flag-fi.svg|30px]]</span>
|lv=<span style="cursor: help;" title="Latvia">[[File:AdminBox-Flag-lv.svg|30px]]</span>
|mx=<span style="cursor: help;" title="Mexico">[[File:AdminBox-Flag-mx.svg|30px]]</span>
|nz=<span style="cursor: help;" title="New Zealand">[[File:AdminBox-Flag-nz.svg|30px]]</span>
|sc=<span style="cursor: help;" title="Scotland">[[File:AdminBox-Flag-sc.svg|30px]]</span>
|tr=<span style="cursor: help;" title="Turkey">[[File:Flag-of-Turkey.svg|30px]]</span>
|uk=<span style="cursor: help;" title="United Kingdom">[[File:AdminBox-Flag-uk.svg|30px]]</span>
|us=<span style="cursor: help;" title="United States">[[File:AdminBox-Flag-us.svg|30px]]</span>
}}</big><br />
<small>Mentor since {{{since|}}}</small><br />{{#ifeq:{{{timezone|}}}|0||<small>[https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/88/World_Time_Zones_Map.png Time zone]: {{{timezone|}}}</small><br />}}
<small>
[[User talk:{{{username}}}|Talk page]] {{#if:{{{discordusername|}}}
|&bull; <span style="cursor: help; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed;" title="{{{discordusername}}}">Discord</span>
|}} {{#if:{{{pronouns|}}}
|&bull; {{{pronouns}}}
|}}</small>{{#ifeq:{{{timezone|}}}|0|<br />&nbsp;|}}
|}
<div style="padding: 5px;"><hr />
{{{content}}}
</div>
</div><noinclude>

==Usage==
<pre>
{{MentorBox
|username=
|flag=
|file=
|since=
|timezone=
|discordusername=
|pronouns=
|content=
}}
</pre>

If the mentor wishes to not reveal timezone, please use <code>|timezone=0</code>.
